headline: Postponed hearing on Mystic Valley Regional Charter School sign variance petition to September 16, 2026.
summary: The board was scheduled to hear Petition 26-007 from Mystic Valley Regional Charter School for a sign variance at 31 Granite St. The hearing could not proceed because notice had not been advertised, so it was postponed to the September 16, 2026 meeting. The meeting was then adjourned.

The Malden Board of Appeal held a Public Hearing Wednesday August 19, 2026, at 6:30 pm at Malden

following named petitions:
Roll Call: Cramer, D’Esposito, Froio and King
Petition 26-007 by Mystic Valley Regional Charter School   seeking a variance under Code of 
the City of Malden as amended –  Title 4 Section 4.16.090 (A) Table of Intensity Regulations: 
Specifically: Awning sign in the Residence A Zoning District as per plans SGER-077161-
2026  at the property known as and numbered 31 Granite St., Malden,  MA and also known by

Shorty before tonight’s meeting we received notification from Alfred Carrier that they did not
